grammar.label: can / could / be able to across tenses
grammar.form: can (present), could (past), will be able to (future), have been able to

explanation.en: 'can' has no future or perfect form — use 'be able to' there.
explanation.uz: 'can' ning kelasi zamon shakli yo'q — 'will be able to' ishlatiladi.

grammar.positive_example: I will be able to drive next year.
grammar.negative_example: I will can drive next year.

l1_notes.uz: Ikki modal ketma-ket kelmaydi: 'will can' NOTO'G'RI.

grammar.label: need to / needn't
grammar.form: need to + base verb; needn't + base verb; don't need to

explanation.en: 'needn't' and 'don't need to' both mean it is not necessary.
explanation.uz: 'needn't' va 'don't need to' — ikkalasi ham 'shart emas' degani.

grammar.positive_example: You don't need to come early.

l1_notes.uz: 'needn't' dan keyin 'to' yo'q; 'need to' dan keyin bor.
